Maya: Heads-up — on staging with H100 I turned on `KERNEL_PICK_DEBUG=1` and saw a surprising path: at seq_len 64 the runtime picked `generic_gemm_v2` instead of `arch_aware_fused` for blocked-attention. Dumping small log excerpt.

Josh: can you paste the log lines?

Maya: ```
[2026-03-10T14:12:01Z] kernel_pick: model=redwood-1 seq=64 hw=H100 candidate=arch_aware_fused score=0.72
[2026-03-10T14:12:01Z] kernel_pick: fallback_reason=throughput_estimate_mismatch; picked=generic_gemm_v2 score=0.68
[2026-03-10T14:12:01Z] autotuner: queue_depth=8 batch_policy=latency pref=0.9
[2026-03-10T14:12:01Z] kv_cache: hit_rate=0.81
```

Li: hmm `fallback_reason` suggests estimator underpredicted fused kernel throughput. Were you running with `RUNTIME_ESTIMATOR_SCALE_OVERRIDE`? Also what's the seq distribution in that run?

Maya: no override. seq histogram attached in trace: most requests are 8-32 but we had a burst of 64-128 (see infra trace)

infra-bot: Perf trace uploaded: https://perf.redwood.internal/trace/xyz123 (staging/h100)

Anita: try toggling `RUNTIME_KERNEL_SELECTION_MODE=autotune_explore` for a few minutes and enable `KERNEL_PICK_VERBOSE=1`. Also add ENV `KERNEL_PICK_SAMPLE_RATE=0.1` so we don't blow logs.

Josh: can we capture additional fields in telemetry? I'd like: `chosen_kernel`, `reason_codes` (list), `estimated_throughput`, `observed_throughput`, `seq_bucket`, `kv_hit_rate`, `autotune_iteration`

Maya: agreed. Also add flag `RUNTIME_KERNEL_DEBUG_ENV=flagwalk` to correlate picks with kernel build stamps.

Li: quick perf note — fused kernels penalize tails at seq <=16 on H100 for attention patching; estimator should reflect per-arch patch penalty. I'll open a PR to include `arch_penalty` in the model.

Anita: Plan: (1) flip selection_mode on staging for 30m (2) increase sample rate for seq>=64 (3) collect telemetry fields Josh listed (4) run perf harness across A100/H100. @Josh @Li volunteer to run harness?

Josh: I'll run A100 harness tonight.

Li: I'll take H100 tomorrow morning.

Maya: thanks — I'll annotate the trace and run the debug flags while you do harnesses. :thumbsup:
